fact: Cameroon Tribune reports that in the Ouest region only 55,097 vulnerable people in eight communes are registered in the Unified Social Registry of Cameroon (RESUC), and the Minister of Social Affairs said a regional session aimed to extend registration to at least ten new communes.

The World Bank paper says RESUC is strengthening its MIS and collecting data to reach a target of 300,000 poor and vulnerable people by 2026, under Component 3 which includes establishing a social registry.

The World Bank paper says RESUC, established under the Ministry of Social Affairs, had 198,140 households covered by July 2025 and has operational systems providing a foundation for targeting and coordination across programmes.
